The detector leg supporting this is the trend-gate eligibility + one_narrative dominance, not the rank.

Per guardrails, crowding is a SIZE-DOWN caution, never a fade — so the directional lens here is simply 'avoid initiating new exposure' rather than betting against them. The detector leg is crowding texture, which is coincident and display-only.
evidence: crowding_z 1.74, crowded=true — the only crowded theme in the top ranks
breadth 0.944 — a nearly universal trade = a crowded intra-china financials narrative
guardrails do_not_conclude: crowding has no forward edge, it only caps size
theses.dissent: Banks have the strongest durability (0.78) and the broadest participation (0.944), which in a genuinely durable leadership would be exactly what you WANT — a concentrated-but-not-reflexive winner; avoiding it may give up the only true trend.
